description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing QUIC cryptographic handshake components, including message creation, packet movement, and key comparison, used in QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: CryptoFramerVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that records handshake messages and errors during cryptographic framing.

classes.name: FullChloGenerator
classes.description: A helper class used to generate full Client Hello (CHLO) messages by extracting SCID and STK from rejection messages and constructing complete handshake messages.

classes.name: TestProofSource
classes.description: A test implementation of ProofSourceX509 that provides a fixed certificate chain for testing.

classes.name: TestProofVerifier
classes.description: A test implementation of ProofVerifier that verifies a fixed certificate chain and hostname for testing purposes.

methods.name: HexChar
methods.description: Parses a character as a hexadecimal digit and outputs its value.

methods.name: CryptoServerConfigForTesting
methods.description: Creates a default QUIC crypto server configuration for testing.

methods.name: HandshakeWithFakeServer
methods.description: Performs a simulated handshake between a client and a fake server for testing.

methods.name: HandshakeWithFakeClient
methods.description: Performs a simulated handshake between a server and a fake client for testing.

methods.name: SetupCryptoServerConfigForTest
methods.description: Initializes a crypto server configuration with default options for testing.

methods.name: SendHandshakeMessageToStream
methods.description: Sends a crypto handshake message into a stream, simulating network transmission.

methods.name: CommunicateHandshakeMessages
methods.description: Simulates the exchange of handshake messages between client and server connections.

methods.name: CommunicateHandshakeMessagesUntil
methods.description: Exchanges handshake messages until specified conditions are met.

methods.name: AdvanceHandshake
methods.description: Advances the handshake process by processing packets between client and server.

methods.name: GetValueForTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific tag in a handshake message.

methods.name: LeafCertHashForTesting
methods.description: Generates a hash of a test certificate chain for testing purposes.

methods.name: FillInDummyReject
methods.description: Fills a handshake message with dummy rejection data for testing.

methods.name: CompareCrypters
methods.description: Compares the keys and IVs of two crypters for equality.

methods.name: CompareClientAndServerKeys
methods.description: Compares the cryptographic keys and parameters of client and server streams.

methods.name: ParseTag
methods.description: Parses a string into a QuicTag, supporting hex and ASCII formats.

methods.name: CreateCHLO
methods.description: Creates a CryptoHandshakeMessage representing a Client Hello with specified tags and values.

methods.name: MovePackets
methods.description: Transfers packets from a source connection to a destination connection and stream, processing frames.

methods.name: GenerateDefaultInchoateCHLO
methods.description: Generates a default inchoate Client Hello message for testing.

methods.name: GenerateClientNonceHex
methods.description: Generates a client nonce in hex format for testing.

methods.name: GenerateClientPublicValuesHex
methods.description: Generates client public values in hex format for testing.

methods.name: GenerateFullCHLO
methods.description: Generates a full Client Hello message based on an inchoate message and configuration.
